I do like to get sample boxes and it seems to be in every sample box I get. I know just give it to a friend who enjoys it because as far as facial cleansers go, I have found many that are quite more effective than this one. I also prefer a more luxurious feeling whether it be from a drugstore or a high-end brand. This does not feel luxurious nor does it provide what my skin needs.

This is a great face wash. Simple and cleansing. Doesn't leave skin feeling stripped. I love this one and I love the moisturizing one as well. The pump makes it so easy to use and I love that. I personally always use a cleansing balm to get makeup off so I can't speak to this for makeup removal
Very good basic cleanser for the price, foams nicely and fragrance free so good for sensitive skin. I do have other cleanser I now prefer that are more targeted to my skin however
One of the best cleansers at the drugstore. It's very gentle and creamy and leaves no irritation whatsoever. The cleanser has no scent which is also a bonus.

I tried the travel size of Cetaphil Daily Facial Cleanser (Fragrance Free) and really liked it. It feels very gentle on the skin, lathers nicely, and rinses off easily without leaving any residue or film. My skin feels fresh and clean after use. I'm considering buying the full size!
Very natural scent, with a thin texture so it's not thick on your face. Packaging was in perfect condition. It really helped my dry skin and it wasn't harsh on my face.

avis.titre: Gentle, effective, and keeps my skin feeling fresh
avis.texte: Cetaphil Daily Face Wash is gentle but still gets my skin really clean. It doesn't leave my face feeling dry or tight, and it's great for everyday use. I like that it's simple, fragrance-free
I love this cleanser. It's super gentle, fragrance free, and keeps my skin clean without drying it out. Perfect for everyday use. I use this in the morning

Cetaphil Daily Face Wash is my every day use facial wash. It is gentle enough for sensitive Skin has quality ingredients and fragrance free. It lathers up, but does not lather too much so that it is easy to rinse off. It will definitely leave your face feeling clean. I love the Cetaphil name and all their products so using their daily face wash was a no-brainer for me.
